name: Galeria (shopping centre, St Petersburg)
note: Shopping centre on Ligovsky Prospekt 30A, St Petersburg (galeria.spb.ru); official partner of HC Shanghai Dragons per the club's 2026-27 partner page. The partner's logo on the club page reads «ГАЛЕРЕЯ САНКТ-ПЕТЕРБУРГ» (the logo file is named 'logotip_gorizont'). Ownership of the mall not traced from open sources.
